Name: Zimri, King of Israel
Summary: Zimri, captain of half Elah's chariots, slew Elah and all Baasha's house, reigned seven days in Tirzah, and when Omri besieged him burned the king's house over himself and died.
KeyStory: Zimri's seven-day reign ends in fire.
RelatedPeople: Elah, King of Israel; Omri, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Seven days of power bought by murder is no reign at all.
